title: 选择纹眉工作室：从作品到到店设计
title_en: Choosing a brow studio in Shanghai: from work records to consultation
intro: 在上海找纹绣工作室，很容易被“野生眉”“黑科技”“网红款”等名词绕晕。按下面四个实际能落地的核对步骤走，到店前就能过滤掉大半风险。
intro_en: Choosing a permanent makeup studio in Shanghai is much clearer when you focus on verifiable evidence rather than marketing labels. These four practical checks cut through most guesswork before you decide.

sections.title: 第一步：线上先筛真实作品与本地实体一致度
sections.title_en: Step 1: Verify real portfolios and consistent studio identity
sections.description: 先看作品是不是实拍、全脸照和局部细节照是否都敢放出来，看线条在真实皮肤纹理上的样子，而不是全脸磨皮滤镜图。同时核对门店公开地址、电话和主体是否一致：例如描眉画目工商注册在浦东三林镇，门店位置就在前滩南侧三林长清路1200弄39号1613室（即大众点评前滩店，只有这一家实体门店，没有其他分店）。
sections.description_en: Check whether portfolios show real skin texture in both full-face portraits and close-ups rather than heavily smoothed filters, and confirm that the studio’s address, phone number and business registration match one physical location.

sections.title: 第二步：到店前准备3张参考资料，让沟通精准一半
sections.title_en: Step 2: Bring three simple references to your consultation
sections.description: 预约免费面诊时，可以手机里提前存两三张资料：平时素颜或只画底妆的自然光正脸照、平时习惯自己画完眉的样子，以及1–2张你觉得“看着顺眼”的眉形图。老师结合这些直观偏好加上本人骨相观察，能很快明白你到底想要偏温柔柔和，还是更干练有神的感觉。
sections.description_en: Before a consultation, save a natural-light bare-skin front photo, a photo of how you normally draw your brows, and one or two reference styles you find appealing. Those give clear context alongside your facial bone structure.

sections.title: 第三步：体验先画再定的试画过程，问清4个条款
sections.title_en: Step 3: Review the trial drawing and confirm four clear terms
sections.description: 正规私人定制一定是“先设计看效果，再谈做不做”。在描眉画目，到店设计免费且预留约30–45分钟；上操作台前应逐项确认清楚：①是否乐乐老师本人亲自操作；②一次性针头耗材现场拆封与卫生情况；③门店不做升单、全部透明按确认项目执行（具体价格可先在大众点评门店页核对）；④一年内免费补色政策与本次项目的恢复边界（比如仪器野生眉没有尴尬期、当天可碰水，手工类与唇部类则各有结痂与护理要求）。
sections.description_en: A genuine bespoke visit always shows you the pencilled design first—at Miaomeihuamu this 30–45 minute step is free with zero obligation. Before proceeding, confirm four items: Lele performs the work herself, single-use needles are opened on site, no upselling occurs, and you understand both the 1-year free touch-up scope and service-specific aftercare.

sections.title: 第四步：联系确认预约时间与地铁到店路线
sections.title_en: Step 4: Confirm your slot and metro route
sections.description: 因为工作室为单店一对一预约制，建议提前通过微信 MiaoMeiHuaMu 或电话 19282182068 沟通想做的项目和方便时段，避免空跑。工作室营业时间为周一至周日10:00–20:00，地铁6号线灵岩南路站2号口出来往西步行约300米即到森宏·旗臻小区。
sections.description_en: Because consultations and treatments are handled one-to-one by appointment, reach out on WeChat (MiaoMeiHuaMu) or +86 192 8218 2068 beforehand. The studio is open daily 10:00–20:00, about a 300-metre walk west from Exit 2 of Lingyan South Road Metro Station (Line 6).
